**Accuracy:** 100% diagnostic accuracy with sub-millimeter precision

### 3. Treatment Planning
Personalized treatment plans developed by experienced radiation oncologists using advanced software to maximize tumor targeting while protecting healthy tissue.

## Common Patient Questions

### Q: What is radiotherapy?
A: Radiotherapy (radiation therapy) uses high-energy radiation to shrink tumors and kill cancer cells. It is one of the most common and effective cancer treatments, often used in combination with surgery and chemotherapy.

### Q: Is radiation therapy safe?
A: Yes. Modern radiotherapy is highly precise and targets only the tumor while minimizing damage to surrounding healthy tissue. All treatments are carefully planned and monitored by experienced radiation oncologists. Our clinic uses advanced technology to ensure maximum safety and effectiveness.

### Q: How long does a treatment session take?
A: A typical radiation therapy session lasts 15-30 minutes. The actual radiation delivery takes only a few minutes; the remaining time is used for patient positioning and imaging verification to ensure precise treatment delivery.

### Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: You can book an appointment online through our [booking page](https://yourdomain.com/booking) or by calling +1 (234) 567-890. Most consultation slots are confirmed within two minutes. We recommend booking in advance for the best availability.

### Q: Do I need a referral from a physician?
A: While a referral from a physician is recommended, it is not always required. Contact our clinic to discuss your situation and determine the best path forward. Our team will guide you through the process.

### Q: What should I expect during my first visit?
A: During your first visit, you'll meet with a radiation oncologist who will review your medical history, discuss your diagnosis, and explain treatment options. The consultation typically takes 30-45 minutes. Bring any relevant medical records and imaging results.

### Q: How accurate is your diagnostic imaging?
A: Our 3.0T wide-bore MRI and advanced CT scanner provide 100% diagnostic accuracy with sub-millimeter precision for treatment planning. This level of accuracy ensures the most effective treatment delivery.

### Q: Do you accept insurance?
A: Yes, we accept most major insurance providers. Our billing team will help verify your coverage before treatment begins. We accept cash, credit cards, and insurance. Contact us for specific insurance questions.

### Q: What makes your clinic different from others?
A: Our clinic combines advanced technology (3.0T MRI, CT scanner, modern radiation therapy systems) with experienced medical professionals. We provide personalized treatment plans, comprehensive patient support, and maintain the highest accreditations (DICOM, HIPAA, ACR, ISO 9001:2015).

### Q: How many years of experience does your team have?
A: Our team has over 15 years of experience in radiation oncology and cancer treatment. Our radiation oncologists are board-certified and have extensive experience in treating various types of cancer using modern radiotherapy techniques.

## Treatment Process Overview

### Step 1: Initial Consultation
Schedule and attend an initial consultation with a radiation oncologist to review your medical history, discuss your diagnosis, and explore treatment options.
**Duration:** 30-45 minutes
**Location:** https://yourdomain.com/booking

### Step 2: Diagnostic Imaging
Undergo advanced diagnostic imaging including 3.0T MRI and CT scan for precise treatment planning and tumor localization.
**Technology:** 3.0T MRI, CT Scanner
**Duration:** 30-60 minutes

### Step 3: Treatment Planning
Our radiation oncologists create a personalized treatment plan using advanced software to target tumors while protecting healthy tissue.
**Duration:** 1-2 weeks
**Technology:** Advanced treatment planning systems

### Step 4: Treatment Delivery
Receive precision radiation therapy sessions lasting 15-30 minutes each, carefully monitored by experienced medical staff.
**Frequency:** Typically daily, 5 days per week
**Duration per session:** 15-30 minutes

### Step 5: Follow-up Care
Attend scheduled follow-up appointments for monitoring, imaging verification, and ongoing patient support.
**Frequency:** As recommended by your oncologist
